product.ta-20-compact.summary: The TA 20 Compact brought typing, calculation and invoicing together in a desktop machine.
product.ta-20-compact.history: A Spanish advertisement in 1980 offered it to small and medium-sized businesses for invoicing, accounting and correspondence. It was the desktop model in the TA 20 range.
product.ta-20-compact.technical.configur: Fixed memory held the built-in programs. The family sheet distinguishes 5 KiB of PROM and 3 KiB of RAM.
product.ta-20-compact.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-20-compact.technical.limitati: The PROM and board identification are needed to verify startup.
